--- grant_execute_on_models.sql
GRANT EXECUTE ON MODEL MyModel, OtherModel TO ROLE MyRole, OtherRole

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnModel{
    Execute: 6,
    Names:   []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 23,
            NameEnd: 30,
            Name:    "MyModel",
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 32,
            NameEnd: 42,
            Name:    "OtherModel",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 51,
      NameEnd: 57,
      Name:    "MyRole",
    },
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 59,
      NameEnd: 68,
      Name:    "OtherRole",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT EXECUTE ON MODEL MyModel, OtherModel TO ROLE MyRole, OtherRole
